name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Grzegorz Braun
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection that Grzegorz Braun, a Polish member of the European Parliament, holds as an elected representative. Polish prosecutors asked for this because they want to charge him over two incidents on 10 July 2025 in Jedwabne, during commemorations of a massacre of Jewish people. They say he blocked a public road and refused police orders to let vehicles pass. Lifting his protection lets the Polish case go ahead.

- Polish prosecutors can now pursue charges against Grzegorz Braun over the 2025 road incidents.
- It affects Grzegorz Braun, a member of the European Parliament elected in Poland.
- The Parliament's President sends the decision to Polish authorities and to Braun.
